title: 'Michael Jordan Mentality' Could Push Jalen Hurts' Eagles Through Training Camp And To A Super Bowl Repeat - NewsBreak
text: Throughout the 2025 offseason, Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has been seen hanging around iconic NBA superstar Michael Jordan. And it seems as though one of the most transformative athletes in the history of American sports might be causing a "Jordan mentality'' to influence the thinking of the rest of the Eagles. And coming off a Super Bowl title last season - with all the challenges that come with trying to re-climb that mountain? Perhaps a "Jordan mentality'' is exactly what Philadelphia needs for this season. "Whatever we did last year, that's in the rearview mirror,” Eagles tackle Jordan Mailata said this week. “We're not defending nothing. We're not the defending champs. We're the 2024 World Champions. That's it. We're not defending (expletive). We're not. “We just won the title, and now we got to go win it again. Prove it all over again, and that's the mentality this team is gonna have. We're not gonna prove anything to anyone else, but ourselves.” Hurts has echoed Mailata's comments about moving past the Super Bowl last season. It might be valuable to consider how different that mindset might be from other Super Bowl champions. The Chiefs, for example, followed their back-to-back title success by agreeing to participate in documentary with ESPN that is airing before the 2025 season. Some might say Kansas City should be looking forward instread. Michael Jordan's impact hasn't just been felt on the basketball court, of course. Plenty of baseball, hockey, and football teams have tried to emulate his relentless mindset. And if 5he 2025 Eagles can close in on capturing that sensibility? It might help them close in on another Super Bowl.
